reason: The image-only reading left the opening words of several lines and the turn-in and strip readings uncertain; comparison with the printed missal resolved them ('dicet rex', 'hy', 'd(omi)n(u)m dum', '[fa]ciem tu') and placed the texts in the Lenten Mass sequence.
sources: Missale ad notulam dominorum Teutonicorum, Hagenau 1519, BSB Res/2 Liturg. 312, fol. XXVII r-v (MDZ bsb10197441 scans 91-92): Feria II post Invocavit, Ez 34:11-16, Mt 25:31-46
Missale ad notulam dominorum Teutonicorum, Hagenau 1519, fol. XXXIIII r-v (MDZ bsb10197441 scans 105-106): Feria II post Reminiscere, Dan 9:15-19, Jn 8:21-29
text:
Source-assisted reading of F-v7a4, made after comparison with the 1519 Teutonic Order missal (MDZ bsb10197441). Reread on the native images: canvas 1, both columns lines 1-16 and the turn-in; canvas 0, the readable strip column lines 1-7 and the stained preceding column lines 1-5. Abbreviations are expanded in (); [] = supplied or not visible; ? = uncertain.

Canvas 1 (StAL_B_234_Bd_12_Textfragment_aussen), column a, native box 366,376,1403,1861 (Ezekiel 34:11b-14)
1  [visi]tabo illas. Sicut uisitat pas
2  tor gregem suu(m) in die quando
3  fu(er)it in medio ouiu(m) suar(um) dissi
4  patar(um): sic uisitabo oues meas
5  & lib(er)abo eas de omnib(us) locis in
6  quib(us) disp(er)se fuera(n)t. in die nu
7  bis & caliginis. Et educam
8  eas de p(o)p(u)lis. et (con)gregabo eas
9  de t(er)ris: et induca(m) eas i(n) t(er)ram
10 suam. et pasca(m) eas in montib(us)
11 Isr(ae)l. in riuis in cunctis sedib(us)
12 t(er)re. In pascuis uberrimis pasca(m)
13 eas: et in montib(us) excelsis isr(ae)l
14 erunt pascue ea(rum). Ibi requiescent
15 in herbis uirentib(us): & in pascu
16 is pinguib(us) pascent(ur) sup(er) mo[ntes]

11 dete paratu(m) uobis regnu(m) a con

15 Hospes eram: et collegistis me
16 [N...]? (under a loose flap)
